g.text: Week 2 — Add a normal task (main success scenario)
Precondition: manager exists, saved tasks have been
loaded, and the initial page has been rendered.
type "Buy milk" and click Add Task
buildTaskRow(id, desc, completed, priority, createdAt, true)
buildTaskRow(id, desc, completed, priority, createdAt, true)
flash newly added row; schedule removal after 1500 ms
new task is visible in To do
Success: the task is saved and displayed.
A reload loads it from localStorage.
Rejected short input is a separate scenario.
